name: week
title: Freight audit: this week
subtitle: What needs a person, and the money waiting on a decision

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select item, what, why, due from attention order by due, item

sections.title: Open findings
sections.sql: select invoice_no as invoice, carrier, connote, rule as check_failed, currency, variance_cents, dispute_by from open_findings order by dispute_by, variance_cents desc
sections.note: Positive amounts were billed above the agreed rate. Accept, waive or dispute each one before the dispute window closes.

sections.title: Disputes waiting on a carrier
sections.sql: select code as dispute, carrier, invoice_no as invoice, raised_on, days_open, currency, claimed_cents, credited_cents, outstanding_cents from dispute_aging where status in ('open', 'part_credited') order by raised_on

name: carriers
title: Carrier scorecard
subtitle: Who bills what was agreed, and who does not

sections.title: Billing accuracy by carrier
sections.sql: select carrier, name, invoices, lines, lines_with_findings, error_rate_pct as error_rate_percent, currency, overbilled_cents, credited_cents from carrier_scorecard order by overbilled_cents desc

sections.title: Surcharges billed
sections.sql: select c.code as carrier, l.charge_code as surcharge, count(*)::int as times_billed, i.currency, sum(l.amount_cents)::bigint as billed_cents, count(f.id)::int as challenged from invoice_lines l join invoices i on i.id = l.invoice_id join carriers c on c.id = i.carrier_id left join findings f on f.invoice_line_id = l.id where l.kind = 'surcharge' group by c.code, l.charge_code, i.currency order by billed_cents desc

sections.title: Rate cards
sections.sql: select code as rate_card, carrier, service, valid_from, valid_to, days_left, lanes from rate_card_expiry order by valid_to

name: month-end
title: Freight month end
subtitle: The accrual for freight shipped but not billed, and cost by cost centre

sections.title: Accrual by cost centre
sections.sql: select cost_centre, currency, count(*)::int as consignments, sum(estimate_cents)::bigint as accrual_cents from unbilled group by cost_centre, currency order by cost_centre
sections.note: Estimated from the agreed rate cards: freight, fuel levy and requested surcharges.

sections.title: Shipped, not billed
sections.sql: select connote, carrier, ship_date, cost_centre, currency, estimate_cents, days_since_shipped from unbilled order by ship_date

sections.title: Billed freight by cost centre
sections.sql: select month, cost_centre, carrier, currency, consignments, billed_cents from cost_allocation order by month desc, cost_centre, carrier
